get.description: Lists tickers with last price, 24-hour change and volume. Filter by exchange, quote currency and listing state; page with limit and offset.

parameters.name: dax
parameters.description: Exchange key to filter by, for example BIN. Omit to include every exchange.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Quote currency to filter by, for example USDT. Omit for every quote currency.

parameters.name: inExchange
parameters.description: When true, only tickers currently listed on the exchange; when false, only the others. Omit for both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return, from 1 to 500. Default 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of rows to skip, counted from zero. Add the limit to move to the next page. Default 0.

get.description: Finds tickers whose symbol contains the search text, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to look for inside the ticker symbol. Case-insensitive; matches anywhere in the symbol. Required.

parameters.description: Exchange key to filter by, for example BIN. Omit to include every exchange.

parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return, from 1 to 100. Default 25.
